title: The Great Lambda Migration to Kubernetes Jobs: a Journey in Three Parts
summary: A first-person account of how Firefly moved event-driven work off Lambda (after hitting the 15-minute timeout), briefly onto ECS, and finally onto Kubernetes Jobs on EKS, with practical notes on reusing container images, swapping an IAM trust policy for EKS OIDC, moving environment variables into ConfigMaps and a blue/green cutover. It is one company’s story with few numbers, and the author’s employer sells infrastructure-as-code tooling, which colours the emphasis on IaC.
